name: Klipa AI
summary: A browser video toolkit that turns long videos into vertical clips with animated subtitles, silence and filler removal, dubbing and AI-written scripts.
description: A browser video toolkit that turns long videos into vertical clips with animated subtitles, silence and filler removal, dubbing and AI-written scripts.

pricing.details: Free trial credits (10 without an account + 10 with a free account, per tool; Klipa logo on the output). Pro 14.99 €/month or 9.90 €/month billed 118.80 €/year; Studio 39 €/month or 33 €/month billed 396 €/year. Official euro prices.
pricing.label: Premium

features: Turns long videos into vertical clips
Animated subtitles, silence and filler removal
Dubbing in 32 languages and AI-written scripts
Trial credits with a logo on the output

howToUse.description: Upload a video on klipa.ai, pick a tool (AI clips, subtitles, reframe), export the result, and subscribe to Pro or Studio to remove the logo and get monthly credits.
